svg.title: 53 courses, stacked year by year
svg.desc: Selected coursework from a Bachelor's in Mechatronics Engineering and a Master's in Electrical and Computer Engineering, drawn as periodic-table tiles stacked by year and coloured by layer, from people and math at the base up to digital hardware, robotics and software. Each layer lights up in turn.
svg.text: People and math at the base, software on top.
